metadata.system: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen (D&D 5th Edition)
metadata.source: Adapted from the D&D 5E SRD equipment list and Dragonlance-specific material culture
metadata.era: War of the Lance (and other ages of Krynn)
metadata.currency_note: Steel pieces (stl) are the premier currency of post-Cataclysm Krynn — steel itself grew scarce after the Cataclysm disrupted dwarven mining, making it more valuable than gold. Regional exchange rates vary slightly (e.g. the Minotaur Isles value steel above the mainland standard, the Seeker Lands below it), but this catalog prices everything at the common mainland rate for simplicity.

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: Finesse, Light, Thrown (range 20/60). Favored backup weapon across Ansalon.

items.name: Club

items.name: Mace

items.notes: Martial weapon.

items.name: Rapier

items.name: Scimitar

items.name: Shortsword
items.notes: Finesse, Light.

items.name: Warhammer

items.name: War Pick
items.notes: Martial weapon.

items.name: Trident
items.notes: Thrown (range 20/60), Versatile (1d8 two-handed). Common among coastal folk and minotaurs.

items.name: Whip
items.notes: Finesse, Reach.

items.name: Greataxe
items.notes: Heavy, Two-Handed.

items.name: Greatsword
items.notes: Heavy, Two-Handed. Wielded by elite Knights and veteran soldiers.

items.name: Greatclub
items.notes: Two-Handed. Favored by ogres and hill folk alike.

items.name: Glaive
items.notes: Heavy, Reach, Two-Handed.

items.name: Halberd
items.notes: Heavy, Reach, Two-Handed.

items.name: Lance
items.notes: Reach, requires a mount. Standard for mounted Solamnic Knights and Dragon Highlord cavalry.

items.name: Maul
items.notes: Heavy, Two-Handed.

items.name: Pike
items.notes: Heavy, Reach, Two-Handed. Standard for militia formations.

items.name: Dragonlance
items.notes: Heavy, Reach, Two-Handed. The legendary lance forged to pierce a dragon's hide; not for ordinary sale, only found, gifted, or forged through the deeds of legend.

items.name: Qualinesti Silverwood Quarterstaff
items.notes: Versatile (1d8 two-handed). Elven-crafted from living silverwood; lighter and finer balanced than common quarterstaves.

items.name: Kagonesti War Spear
items.notes: Thrown (range 20/60). Barbed flint or bone head favored by Kagonesti hunters.

items.name: Thorbardin Forged Battleaxe
items.notes: Versatile (1d10 two-handed). Dwarven masterwork steel that holds an edge for generations.

items.name: Hylar Stonecraft Warhammer
items.notes: Versatile (1d10 two-handed). Favored by Hylar nobles and temple guards of Reorx.

items.name: Daergar Black Iron Shortsword
items.notes: Finesse, Light. Treated to a dull black finish that doesn't catch torchlight, favored by dark dwarves.

items.name: Minotaur Boarding Axe
items.notes: Heavy. A naval weapon designed to hook rigging and cleave through hull planking alike.

items.name: Minotaur War Trident
items.notes: Versatile (1d10 two-handed). A heavier trident favored by Imperial Navy marines.

items.name: Solamnic Honor Blade
items.notes: Versatile (1d10 two-handed). A ceremonial longsword bearing a Knightly Order's crest; carrying one without rank invites hard questions.

items.name: Nerakan Black Iron Shortsword
items.notes: Finesse, Light. Mass-produced standard issue for Dragonarmy infantry.

items.name: Draconian Claw-Forged Scimitar
items.notes: Finesse, Light. A curved blade favored by Sivak officers, its hilt wrapped in cured draconian hide.

items.name: Ogre-Hewn Greatclub
items.notes: Two-Handed. A crude, massive club sized for an ogre's grip; unwieldy in smaller hands.

items.name: Plainsman Hunting Spear
items.notes: Thrown (range 20/60), Versatile (1d8 two-handed). Carried by Que-Shu and Que-Kiri hunters alike.

items.name: Icereach Bone Harpoon
items.notes: Thrown (range 20/60). Carved from walrus bone by Arktos and Thanoi alike for hunting and war.

items.name: Footpad's Sap
items.notes: Light. A leather-wrapped lead weight favored by thieves' guild enforcers for quiet, nonlethal persuasion.

items.name: Gnomish Spring-Loaded Knife
items.notes: Light, Finesse. A folding blade on a coiled spring; deploys instantly, occasionally without warning.

items.name: Seeker's Hollow Mace
items.notes: A gilded but hollow ceremonial mace carried by Seeker priests; more theater than weapon.

items.name: Shortbow
items.notes: Ammunition (range 80/320), Two-Handed.

items.name: Longbow
items.notes: Ammunition (range 150/600), Heavy, Two-Handed. The mark of a trained Qualinesti or Kagonesti archer.

items.name: Light Crossbow
items.notes: Ammunition (range 80/320), Loading, Two-Handed.

items.name: Heavy Crossbow
items.notes: Ammunition (range 100/400), Heavy, Loading, Two-Handed.

items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.notes: Ammunition (range 30/120), Light, Loading.

items.name: Sling
items.notes: Ammunition (range 30/120). The shepherd's weapon.

items.name: Dart
items.notes: Finesse, Thrown (range 20/60).

items.name: Net
items.notes: Thrown (range 5/15), Special. Restrains a creature rather than damaging it.

items.name: Blowgun
items.notes: Ammunition (range 25/100), Loading.

items.name: Arrows (20)
items.notes: Ammunition for shortbows and longbows.

items.name: Crossbow Bolts (20)
items.notes: Ammunition for crossbows.

items.name: Sling Bullets (20)
items.notes: Ammunition for slings.

items.name: Qualinesti Silverwood Longbow
items.notes: Ammunition (range 150/600), Heavy, Two-Handed. Elven masterwork, lighter and quieter than common longbows.

items.name: Kagonesti Short Hunting Bow
items.notes: Ammunition (range 80/320), Two-Handed. Compact bow suited to forest hunting.

items.name: Plains Pony Bow
items.notes: Ammunition (range 80/320), Two-Handed. A short recurve bow made for firing from horseback.

items.name: Minotaur Repeating Crossbow
items.notes: Ammunition (range 80/320), Two-Handed. A naval siege-deck weapon with a hand-cranked magazine; rare outside the Imperial Navy.

items.name: Gnomish Multi-Bolt Crossbow
items.notes: Ammunition (range 60/240), Two-Handed. Fires three bolts in a fan pattern, usually on purpose.

items.name: Thanoi Barbed Throwing Spear
items.notes: Thrown (range 30/90). Bone-barbed spear favored by Thanoi raiders for seal hunting and war alike.

items.name: Padded Armor
items.notes: AC 11 + Dex modifier. Disadvantage on Stealth.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.notes: AC 11 + Dex modifier.

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.notes: AC 12 + Dex modifier.

items.name: Hide Armor
items.notes: AC 12 + Dex modifier (max 2). Common among Plainsmen and frontier folk.

items.name: Chain Shirt
items.notes: AC 13 + Dex modifier (max 2).

items.name: Scale Mail
items.notes: AC 14 + Dex modifier (max 2). Disadvantage on Stealth.

items.name: Breastplate
items.notes: AC 14 + Dex modifier (max 2). A mark of standing among Knights and minor nobles.

items.name: Half Plate
items.notes: AC 15 + Dex modifier (max 2). Disadvantage on Stealth.

items.name: Ring Mail
items.notes: AC 14. Disadvantage on Stealth.

items.name: Chain Mail
items.notes: AC 16. Disadvantage on Stealth. Standard Solamnic Knight armor.

items.name: Splint Armor
items.notes: AC 17. Disadvantage on Stealth.

items.name: Plate Armor
items.notes: AC 18. Disadvantage on Stealth. Worn by Knights of the Rose and Dragon Highlords alike.

items.name: Kagonesti Hide Wraps
items.notes: AC 11 + Dex modifier. Woven bark fiber and supple hide, suited to silent movement through the wood.

items.name: Thorbardin Dwarven Platemail
items.notes: AC 19. Disadvantage on Stealth. Masterwork dwarven plate, rarely sold to outsiders at any price.

items.name: Minotaur Naval Cuirass
items.notes: AC 14 + Dex modifier (max 2). Bronze-fitted leather built for shipboard combat.

items.name: Draconian-scale Hide Armor
items.notes: AC 13 + Dex modifier (max 2). Grim trophy armor cured from a slain draconian's scaled hide.

items.name: Seeker Ceremonial Robes
items.notes: AC 10 (no Dex bonus). Gilded vestments meant to impress congregations, not stop blades.

items.name: Icereach Walrus-hide Armor
items.notes: AC 12 + Dex modifier (max 2). Thick, oiled hide worn by Arktos and Thanoi against the glacier's cold and claws alike.

items.name: Shield
items.notes: +2 AC while wielded.

items.name: Solamnic Crested Kite Shield
items.notes: +2 AC while wielded. Bears a Knightly Order's crest; carrying one without rank invites hard questions.

items.name: Dwarven Standing Shield
items.notes: +2 AC while wielded. Oversized dwarven shield, heavier but broader than a standard shield.

items.name: Backpack
items.notes: Holds a day's worth of provisions plus gear.

items.name: Bedroll
items.notes: Essential for the road between towns.

items.name: Rope, Hempen (50 ft)
items.notes: Climbing, binding, hauling.

items.name: Torch
items.notes: Burns roughly 1 hour.

items.name: Tinderbox
items.notes: Flint, steel, and tinder for starting fires.

items.name: Rations (1 day)
items.notes: Dried meat, hard bread, and fruit.

items.name: Waterskin
items.notes: Holds about 4 pints.

items.name: Holy Symbol
items.notes: Bears the sigil of a true god — Mishakal, Paladine, Kiri-Jolith, and others returning after long silence.

items.name: Spellbook
items.notes: Required for Wizards of High Sorcery to record and prepare spells.

items.name: Component Pouch
items.notes: Small pouch of spell components.

items.name: Crowbar
items.notes: Advantage on Strength checks requiring leverage.

items.name: Grappling Hook
items.notes: Used with rope for climbing.

items.name: Lantern, Hooded
items.notes: Burns 6 hours per pint of oil.

items.name: Healer's Kit
items.notes: Bandages, salves, and splints; ten uses.

items.name: Manacles
items.notes: Used by Knights and town watches to restrain prisoners.

items.name: Climber's Kit
items.notes: Pitons, boot tips, gloves, and a harness.

items.name: Kender Pouch
items.notes: A kender's deep, well-worn belt pouch — somehow always has room for one more 'borrowed' item.

items.name: Tent, Two-Person
items.notes: Shelters two from rain and frost on the road.

items.name: Pole (10-foot)
items.notes: Useful for testing footing, fording streams, or prodding suspicious floors.

items.name: Mess Kit
items.notes: Tin plate, cup, and utensils that nest together.

items.name: Signal Whistle
items.notes: Carried by town watches and militia to raise the alarm.

items.name: Magnifying Glass
items.notes: Useful for close inspection of small details or starting fires in bright sun.

items.name: Ink and Pen Set
items.notes: A small bottle of ink and a quill pen.

items.name: Paper (10 sheets)
items.notes: Fine enough for correspondence and dispatches.

items.name: Antitoxin (vial)
items.notes: Grants resistance to poison for one hour if drunk before exposure.

items.name: Alchemist's Fire (flask)
items.notes: Sticky, combustible liquid that ignites when exposed to air.

items.name: Acid (vial)
items.notes: Corrosive enough to damage materials and flesh alike.

items.name: Block and Tackle
items.notes: Allows one creature to hoist four times the weight it could otherwise lift.

items.name: Caltrops (bag of 20)
items.notes: Scattered to slow pursuers across a square area.

items.name: Hunting Trap
items.notes: A steel-jawed trap favored by trappers and frontier folk.

items.name: Ladder (10-foot)
items.notes: Simple wooden ladder.

items.name: Lock
items.notes: A reasonably sturdy lock, sold with a key.

items.name: Steel Mirror, Hand
items.notes: Polished steel disk; glass mirrors are rarer still since the Cataclysm.

items.name: Oil (flask)
items.notes: Fuels lanterns or can be thrown and ignited.

items.name: Piton
items.notes: Driven into rock or wood to anchor a rope.

items.name: Spyglass
items.notes: Brings distant sails and dragons alike into unwelcome focus.

items.name: Folding Paper Umbrella
items.notes: A gnomish novelty that folds smaller than seems possible; works as advertised about half the time.

items.name: Bubble-Bath Soap
items.notes: Another Mount Nevermind export; produces an alarming volume of bubbles for its size.

items.name: Tinker's Bang-Bug
items.notes: A gnomish clockwork toy that sits quietly, then explodes into harmless noise and flies away. Mostly harmless.

items.name: Gnomish Far-Seer
items.notes: A gnomish spyglass alternative; works brilliantly, except for the lens, the hinge, or the focus, usually one at a time.

items.name: Kender Trinket Collection
items.notes: An assortment of buttons, beads, and curios of no value to anyone but the kender who 'found' them.

items.name: Kender's Mostly Accurate Map
items.notes: Hand-drawn, confidently labeled, and right perhaps two times out of three.

items.name: Symbol of Habbakuk
items.notes: A carved blue heron or fish, sigil of the god of animals and the sea's bounty.

items.name: Symbol of Kiri-Jolith
items.notes: A bison-horned helm sigil, carried by those who hold honor and just war sacred.

items.name: Symbol of Reorx
items.notes: A forge-hammer sigil, favored by dwarven smiths and craftsfolk.

items.name: Black Rosary of Chemosh
items.notes: A string of bone beads carried by death-cult adherents; openly displaying one is rarely wise.

items.name: Plains Hide Tent
items.notes: A conical hide tent favored by Que-Shu and Que-Kiri hunters on the move.

items.name: Arktos Snow Cloak
items.notes: Thick, oiled fur cloak that turns aside Icereach's worst winds.

items.name: Holy Water (flask)
items.notes: Blessed by a true cleric; harms undead and fiendish creatures.

items.name: Smith's Tools
items.notes: Forge work and repairs; prized among Thorbardin dwarves.

items.name: Herbalism Kit
items.notes: Identifying and preparing herbal remedies.

items.name: Thieves' Tools
items.notes: Lockpicks and tools for disarming traps.

items.name: Navigator's Tools
items.notes: Charting courses by land or sea; common among minotaur sailors.

items.name: Disguise Kit
items.notes: Cosmetics and props for altering appearance.

items.name: Forgery Kit
items.notes: Inks, seals, and papers for falsifying documents.

items.name: Cartographer's Tools
items.notes: Mapmaking instruments.

items.name: Cook's Utensils
items.notes: Pots, pans, and implements for trail cooking.

items.name: Brewer's Supplies
items.notes: Mead and ale brewing implements.

items.name: Calligrapher's Supplies
items.notes: Fine pens and inks for formal documents and illuminated manuscripts.

items.name: Carpenter's Tools
items.notes: Saws, planes, and chisels for construction work.

items.name: Cobbler's Tools
items.notes: For repairing and making boots and shoes.

items.name: Jeweler's Tools
items.notes: Fine instruments for cutting and setting gemstones.

items.name: Leatherworker's Tools
items.notes: For curing and shaping hide and leather.

items.name: Mason's Tools
items.notes: Chisels and trowels for stonework; favored among Thorbardin's builders.

items.name: Potter's Tools
items.notes: A potter's wheel tools and glazing supplies.

items.name: Tinker's Tools
items.notes: Small parts and instruments for repairing mechanical devices; ubiquitous among gnomes.

items.name: Weaver's Tools
items.notes: Needles, spindles, and a small loom frame.

items.name: Woodcarver's Tools
items.notes: Knives and gouges for fine woodwork.

items.name: Dice Set
items.notes: A favorite pastime in taverns from Solace to Sanction.

items.name: Playing Card Set
items.notes: Hand-painted cards, often featuring the Knightly Orders or the gods of Krynn.

items.name: Drum
items.notes: A simple hide drum.

items.name: Flute
items.notes: Carved bone or wood; a favorite of Branchala's followers.

items.name: Lute
items.notes: A bard's constant companion.

items.name: Lyre
items.notes: Favored in Qualinesti and Silvanesti courts.

items.name: Horn
items.notes: A simple signal or war horn.

items.name: Steel Ingot
items.notes: Raw steel, scarce since the Cataclysm disrupted the great dwarven mines — as valuable as the coin it's named for.

items.name: Vingaard Steel Ingot
items.notes: Premium smithing steel from Vingaard Keep's forges, prized for blades that hold an edge.

items.name: Furs, Bundle
items.notes: Traded across the northern reaches and Icewall.

items.name: Wool Cloth, Bolt
items.notes: Common trade good across Solamnia and Abanasinia.

items.name: Salt, Pouch
items.notes: Essential preservative and seasoning.

items.name: Grain, Sack
items.notes: A farming village's lifeblood through winter.

items.name: Qualinesti Silverwood Timber, Bundle
items.notes: Prized, pale timber grown only in Qualinesti's groves; exporting it without leave is a serious offense.

items.name: Thorbardin Iron Ore, Sack
items.notes: Raw ore from Thorbardin's deep mines, the foundation of all dwarven steel.

items.name: Thorbardin Gem-grade Quartz
items.notes: Clear crystal favored by dwarven jewelers and a few wizards' foci.

items.name: Silvanesti Wine, Bottle
items.notes: Centuries-old vintages from Silvanesti's royal vineyards; rarely sold to outsiders.

items.name: Qualinesti Elfwine, Bottle
items.notes: A lighter, more widely traded vintage than its Silvanesti cousin.

items.name: Sancrist Whale Oil, Jug
items.notes: Burns clean and bright; a staple export of Sancrist's coastal villages.

items.name: Icereach Walrus Ivory, Piece
items.notes: Carved by Arktos artisans into tools, charms, and trade goods.

items.name: Blood Sea Pearl
items.notes: Harvested at great risk from the Blood Sea's reefs by minotaur divers.

items.name: New Sea Salted Fish, Barrel
items.notes: A staple export of fishing villages along the New Sea.

items.name: Solamnic Wool, Bolt
items.notes: Heavy, well-spun wool from Solamnia's highland flocks.

items.name: Vingaard Valley Wheat, Sack
items.notes: The breadbasket grain of Solamnia, fought over more than once in this war.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Farmhand
npc_equipment_sets.description: An ordinary farmer or laborer, unused to violence.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Town Watchman
npc_equipment_sets.description: A local guard keeping the peace in a frontier village or free city.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Knight of Solamnia
npc_equipment_sets.description: A sworn Knight, bound by the Code and the Measure.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Wizard of High Sorcery
npc_equipment_sets.description: A spellcaster sworn to the White, Red, or Black Robes.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Kender Wanderer
npc_equipment_sets.description: A fearless, tactless kender on the road, pockets full of 'borrowed' curiosities.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Cleric of Mishakal
npc_equipment_sets.description: A healer of the returning gods, tending to refugees and soldiers alike.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Baaz Draconian Soldier
npc_equipment_sets.description: Common infantry of the Dragonarmies, lightly equipped and disposable to their commanders.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Gully Dwarf Scavenger
npc_equipment_sets.description: An Aghar gully dwarf, scraping by on scavenged junk and unshakeable optimism.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Gnome Tinker
npc_equipment_sets.description: An inventor from Mount Nevermind, equipped for fieldwork and minor catastrophe alike.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Minotaur Legionary
npc_equipment_sets.description: A soldier of the Imperial Navy or Great Circus, bound by martial honor.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Qualinesti Archer
npc_equipment_sets.description: An elven scout or soldier of the Qualinesti forests, trained from youth in the bow.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Plainsman Hunter
npc_equipment_sets.description: A Que-Shu or Que-Kiri hunter of the Abanasinian plains.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Seeker False Priest
npc_equipment_sets.description: A pre-War of the Lance fraud peddling false miracles to a faithless age.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Dark Pilgrim Cultist
npc_equipment_sets.description: A secretive follower of one of Takhisis's dark circle, working in the shadows of a free town.
